newsitem.title: UK: UK Japanese stocks steady to higher in quiet trade.
newsitem.headline: UK Japanese stocks steady to higher in quiet trade.

text.p: Japanese shares traded here were steady in thin trade with the market taking an overall higher bias, dealers said.
The Nikkei 50 was 2.19 points up from the Tokyo close at 1,467.09 by 1426 GMT.
"The market's very quiet today and we've just seen a little buying in the banks again," said one dealer.

Dealers said Sanwa, up 4.5 yen at 1364.5, Sekura and Asahi, up 3.5 yen to 782.5, were particularly active. High-tech stocks, Fujitsu, NEC and Sharp saw good two-way business but little price movement, they said.
